task: Issue #494: one release date per language-qualified Jungle launch

ownerDecision.decision: Italian, Dutch and Portuguese Jungle use Bulbapedia's blanket non-English February 2000, marked approximate, instead of the English 1999-06-16 launch. A release date belongs to the language-qualified expansion launch, so holo and non-holo cards of one localized run share it.

sources.captureMethod: curl through the Internet Archive; the live article returned a bot challenge (HTTP 403) and was not bypassed

excerpts.content: The English expansion was released on June 16, 1999, while the Japanese expansion was released on March 5, 1997. Subsequently all other language releases for Jungle were February of 2000.
excerpts.hashScope: exact UTF-8 excerpt only, not full HTTP response

sources.scope: Blanket statement for every non-English, non-Japanese Jungle release. Native German (Juni 2000, PokéWiki) and French (01 juillet 2000, Poképédia) articles contradict it for those localities (release-dates-20261011/historical-sets.json); no native Italian, Dutch or Portuguese date was found in release-dates-20261011 or release-dates-20261012.
